_help: Content of the launcher's Play page (docs/launcher-feed.txt, written by build.py). 'releases' holds the headline for each release, keyed by version without the 'v'; the newest release always leads, and a release without an entry gets a plain 'Update x.y.z is live' slide. The latest devlog post follows automatically. 'slides' and 'news' are fixed items after that. Titles use | for the line break and should stay under about 22 characters a line; texts under about 200 characters. Links may only point to truecombat.eu, github.com, youtube.com, youtu.be, discord.gg or ko-fi.com.

0.34.1.title: Instant replay.|Fairer teams.
0.34.1.text: Press F8 to save the last 30 seconds, see who hit you after every round, and let auto-balance fix lopsided matches.

slides.title: Climb the|ladder.
slides.text: Every official ranked match counts. One full match puts you on the leaderboard.

slides.title: Play|together.
slides.text: Find a squad, join match nights and tell us what to build next on Discord.
